name: 81323 · Dolores, CO
findings: ZIP 81323 (Dolores) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81323 (Dolores) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
